purpose: Fresh prospective audit-only comparison of the unchanged H1 runner50 baseline versus the M10D-reproduced causal compound-loss entry filter, using an independent new start and no retrofit/backfill of M9V/M9Y/M10B.

upstream.eligibility: proxy_primary_time must be strictly greater than the independently frozen M10E prospective start
upstream.native_materialization: RESOLVED_ONLY; a post-start S3_H1 candidate is materialized only after its native M9V EXIT resolves. Native outcome is never an entry/filter condition.

h1_reference.entry: Frozen M10A/M10D H1 reference: original S3_H1; reclaim level = original PRIMARY bid/open - 0.05 * latest fully closed H1 Wilder ATR14 at first-turn; latest fully closed M5 confirmation; max 30 minutes; exact M1 open ask execution; no nearest-M1 fallback.
h1_reference.runner: At native H1 EXIT, latest fully closed H4 MACD(6,13) raw line and latest fully closed D1 MACD(6,13) raw line must both be rising versus their previous fully closed bars; then 50% runner exits at first causal H1 RCI9 turn-down at/after native EXIT.

compound_filter.m5_macd_definition: MACD(6,13) line normalized by latest closed M5 close into bps; slope = latest fully closed M5 MACD bps minus previous fully closed M5 MACD bps
compound_filter.h1_stack_definition: (EMA30 - EMA40) / abs(latest fully closed H1 close) * 10000 bps

review_gates.interpretation: Checkpoints are manual research reviews only. No automatic promotion. Compare baseline and filtered arms on accepted/resolved counts, win rate, PF, payoff, net, DD, loss tail and excluded-entry metadata.
